evidence: Design is graded, not all-or-nothing. scoring.toml: two zero-mass gates, weights functional 0.6/polish 0.2/visual 0.2, functional floor 0.05; score.py:57-59 computes a weighted mean, not a pass/fail. Functional = 16 binary criteria under aggregation=weighted_mean with weights 1.5-4.0 summing to 44 (re-derived: 3+4+4+2+1.5+4+4+2+3+1.5+1.5+1.5+2.5+1.5+4+4), so the smallest step is 1.5/44 (~3.4% of functional); polish = 6 equal binary criteria; visual = 4 likert (points=5, anchored 0-5, weights 2/2/1/1). Functional/polish/visual prompts each say score every criterion independently and the global browser gate is the only all-or-nothing rule. Cross-criterion dependency check: search and transcript legs recur across ~9 criteria (an app with no search would lose up to 29/44 of functional), but both are explicit public requirements and the brief makes them part of the wall/retention promise (walls-and-retention.md: 'not in ... search results ... or a transcript'); incidental search/transcript bugs (case, wildcard %/_/*, missing sent time, missing versions) are isolated to search_and_transcript, other criteria use exact-case searches. Shared-DB cascade checked: e.g. a timer_changes failure that leaves M-13 at 7 days does not remove 'Draft will sent for your review.' (seed 2026-05-10) used later by message_links/live_updates. Plausible weak apps spread: basic chat with replies only -> functional 1.5/44=0.034 < floor -> 0; chat + replies/links/unread/live -> 6/44 functional and nonzero reward; strong app with a few leaks -> ~0.7-0.8. Indicative runtime spread exists only on PREVIOUS v2 bytes (hashes verified): Oracle 0.9917, nop 0, GPT-5.6 0.8114 with functional 0.7273 (4 of 16 criteria failed: signin_and_client_scope, wall_mentions_and_links, unread_and_new_messages_line, search_and_transcript) and visual 0.875. RISK: raw-evidence-index.json states reward discrimination/ranking on these bytes and any full configured judge run are absent; v3 adds legs to five functional criteria, making each binary bundle more conjunctive, so the realised spread on v3 is unmeasured. Secondary risk: most functional criteria depend on recording and replaying HTTP requests; an app moving loads/writes onto WebSocket frames could fail many criteria together, not exercised.
